name: px-verify
description: px's verification gate as a DeepSeek Harness plugin: on agent/turn-stopping, run the repository's own test command and steer the model back when it fails

scripts.typecheck: npm run link-types && tsc --noEmit src/index.ts --target es2024 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --allowImportingTsExtensions --strict --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --exactOptionalPropertyTypes --noImplicitOverride --noFallthroughCasesInSwitch --skipLibCheck --types node
scripts.build: npm run link-types && tsc src/index.ts --outDir lib --declaration --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --target es2024 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --allowImportingTsExtensions --strict --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --exactOptionalPropertyTypes --noImplicitOverride --noFallthroughCasesInSwitch --skipLibCheck --types node
scripts.mount: npm run build && mkdir -p "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/px-verify" && cp lib/index.js "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/px-verify/index.js" && printf '%s\n' '{ "name": "px-verify", "private": true, "version": "0.0.0", "type": "module", "main": "index.js" }' > "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/px-verify/package.json"
